**VCS adapter slice — planning artifacts created (full-adapter scope, chained PRs)**

What: Scaffolded the VCS adapter slice (full-adapter scope chosen by user). Planning artifacts done, no implementation code yet.

Artifacts:
- brain/project/decisions/adr-0008-adapter-vcs-provider.md — decision record (explicit vcs.provider, verb contract, adapter pattern mirroring memory adapter).
- openspec/changes/vcs-adapter/proposal.md — scope, 10 verbs, acceptance criteria, rollback.
- openspec/changes/vcs-adapter/design.md — provider interface (normalized shapes), normalization table (gh↔glab), per-script refactor mapping, chained-PR plan.
- openspec/changes/vcs-adapter/tasks.md — work units grouped by PR1..PR6.
- brain/HOME.md — indexed ADR-0008 (required by brain:nav).

10 abstract verbs (from exploration): authCheck, authLogin, whoami, issueView, issueList, mrList, commitStatus, repoCloneUrl, patSetupUrl, projectResolve(no-op on GitHub). Tricky: project-resolve is GitLab-only (numeric id), commitStatus enum differs (GH failure→failed, cancelled→canceled), repoCloneUrl user literal oauth2→x-access-token, iid→number normalization.

Chained-PR plan: PR1 foundation (contract+migration v0.2.0+dispatcher+skeletons, zero behavior change) → PR2 providers (github.mjs+gitlab.mjs) → PR3 read-only callers (tracker-board, project-status) → PR4 day-start → PR5 ticket-start → PR6 bootstrap.sh+install-tools.sh.

5 scripts couple to glab today: ticket-start, tracker-board, project-status, day-start, bootstrap.sh (+install-tools installs glab). gitlab.mjs provider must preserve exact current behavior (parity, safe revert).

Status: planning DONE, repo:check + brain:nav green. NEXT: implement PR1. Related: [[architecture/vcs-adapter]] (decision), [[convention/adr-placement]].
